'''Deehan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] dispatched by [[Binna Jode]] gave Deehan a toy to give to the [[Youngling/Legends|children]] of a family injured by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
Deehan was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Binna Jode and her [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] involving Deehan was removed from the game during the "Bestine Redesign" update during [[W:c:swg:Publish 6 Notes: 11 February 04|Publish 6: ''The Imperial Crackdown'']] on [[February 11]], [[2004]].<ref name="Publish 6">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60893|text=Publish 6: The Imperial Crackdown}}</ref>
